status: Frozen before any inference on the selected Qwen3.5 export; development only, not externally preregistered or confirmatory
purpose: Establish baseline relation and attribute competence, native hybrid-state access, bounded resource behavior and full-prefix versus split-prefix consistency before selecting an intervention experiment.
system: Answer questions about the short story. Reply with only the requested person's name or color, without explanation.

stories.story: At the museum, Alice gave a red book to Bob.
At the museum, Bob gave a red book to Alice.
At the school, Clara gave a blue book to David.
At the school, David gave a blue book to Clara.

rendering: Exact text-only system+user subset of the pinned community chat_template.jinja: user is story + newline + question. add_generation_prompt=true; enable_thinking=false. No demonstrations, tools, images, or vision inputs. Assistant prefix includes the template's empty think pair. No answer is supplied in the prompt.
decoding: Greedy argmax over all 248320 logits, at most four generated tokens, stopping at configured EOS. Save native top token and complete bounded answer. Scoring uses case-sensitive decoded content after strip() only; no punctuation cleanup, name-only restricted decoder, or post-hoc alias allowance.
stages: Prepare and hash all twelve prompt/token fixtures without model inference.
One first-case smoke run, with full-prefix and two-chunk prefix evaluation, before the four serial three-query baseline batches.
Execute and report all twelve fixtures regardless of correctness, unless resource or numerical integrity bounds stop execution. Do not edit exposed prompts under this protocol.

baseline_gate.purpose: Gate whether a later new, separately frozen intervention experiment has adequate development competence. Does not license selection of only successful evaluation cases.

integrity.split_prefix: Split the first prompt at floor(token_count / 2), pass every returned conv/recurrent/KV tensor and absolute text positions. Compare final full-vocabulary logits and all state tensors with one-shot prefill.
integrity.quantization_scope: Single community q4 export; no upstream full-precision equivalence asserted. Native ONNX outputs, not a reimplemented Transformer.

claim_limits: This is development baseline assessment, not a held-out intervention result.
The model has attention and recurrent/convolutional state. Restoring KV alone is not restoring its complete computation state.
No base-weight learning, modern-model editing, human-oversight benefit, intelligence-gap result, biological validation, or DeepSeek/MoE execution follows from this baseline.
All failures, outputs, resource stops and deviations remain preserved.
